# Study with Gaurav (Study-With-gaurav)

> The #1 centralized open-access student resource directory indexing verified educational portals, Physics Wallah (PW) study portals, Rojgar With Ankit (RWA) preparation resources, Next Toppers, IIT School, and 100+ verified educational hubs.

## Core Information
- **Website Name**: Study with Gaurav (also known as Study-With-gaurav)
- **Primary Domain**: https://studywithgaurav.cc.cd
- **Alternative Mirror**: https://studywithgaurav-ten.vercel.app/
- **Main Portal URL**: www.studywithgaurav.cc.cd
- **Platform Purpose**: Free, instant student access to verified competitive exam preparation resources, PDF notes, live/recorded lecture gateways, and top institute study materials across India.

## Key Target Categories & Platforms
- **Physics Wallah (PW)**: Official portals, student hubs, Lakshya, Yakeen, Arjuna preparation links.
- **Rojgar With Ankit (RWA)**: RWA official, SSC/Police/Railway exam notes and foundation links.
- **Next Toppers**: High school and 10th/12th board exam preparation portals.
- **IIT School**: IIT-JEE Advanced & Main preparation portals, revision formula sheets, free educational lectures.
- **Selection Way**: Career guidance and competitive selection portals.
- **MissionJEET**: Engineering entrance preparation series and batch portals.
- **CDS JOURNEY**: Defence exams (CDS, NDA, AFCAT) complete syllabus guidance & lecture series.
- **Study IQ & Khan Global Studies (KGS)**: UPSC, State PSC, and SSC current affairs & GS notes.
- **Vibrant Academy & Padhle Akshay**: Science, Mathematics, and high school board revision sheets.

## Popular Educational Search Queries Addressed
- Study-With-gaurav, studywithgaurav.cc.cd, studywithgaurav-ten.vercel.app
- Physics Wallah study portals, PW lecture notes, PW formula sheets
- Rojgar With Ankit notes, RWA exam preparation guides
- Free educational portals, foundation batches, lectures, study material PDF
- IIT School study resources, Next Toppers board study notes
